purpose: Record the native failure caused by returning a metadata-only base package during a bounded local game handshake.

build_notes: connector and game traffic routed to loopback through ADB reverse
production endpoints and certificate policy were not contacted

assessment.finding: A metadata-only package can drive the native script-space setup into a null dereference in this diagnostic build.
assessment.likely_cause: The synthetic package contains no FILE or script definitions required by the normal startup graph.
not_proven: A live server can deliver this exact package to an unmodified client.
The same crash occurs in the ARM64 build or on physical hardware.
The crash is exploitable beyond denial of service.
The package verifier accepts arbitrary metadata-only packages in production.
assessment.next_test: Build a minimal valid package with the required script and resource records, then repeat the render replay under a debugger or tombstone capture.

raw_data_policy: Raw APKs, native files, packet captures, login fields, and package bodies remain outside the repository.
